description: With winter approaching and the temperatures starting to drop, it’s time to touch on puffy winter jackets in car seats. Keeping puffy jackets on in car seats is not safe! The extra padding the jacket provides significantly increases the amount of slack in the car seat, and as demonstrated, when removing the jacket, it is far too loose and does not pass the pinch test!  #carseatsafety #cpst #momtips
